name: Credit spreads
summary: US high-yield spreads 3.43%, inside the 4% Watch line
state: The US high-yield option-adjusted spread was 3.43% on 2 Nov, inside the 4% Watch line though close to its widest in a year and about 33bp wider than a month earlier. There is no sign of a broad credit squeeze as of 4 Nov.
for_you: Borrowing conditions for riskier companies remain open; wider spreads would signal tighter credit for businesses.
why: High-yield spreads show how much lenders demand to fund weaker companies — an early warning of defaults and credit crunches.
drivers: Default expectations, risk appetite, rates, private-credit stress, fund outflows.

rubric.alert: HY OAS > 6.0%, or widened > 200bp in a month.
rubric.watch: HY OAS 4.0–6.0%, or widened > 100bp in a month.
